description: This Kotlin file defines a composable function Plot3DScreen that creates and displays a 3D plot using GLSurfaceView hosted inside an AndroidView. It initializes a Plot3DRenderer, sets up the OpenGL surface, and updates the renderer with new data points.

methods.name: Plot3DScreen
methods.description: A composable function that creates a GLSurfaceView for rendering 3D radar points using Plot3DRenderer, hosting it within an AndroidView and updating the renderer with new points.
